decisions_2026_10_29: Navin's yes of 29 October 2026, recorded where each applies: sources.approved_by_navin (india-code, gmt-earth-relief, bodyparts3d), sources.needs_navin hipparcos (yes given, ESA's commercial terms still unchecked, kept out of lessons; the Yale Bright Star Catalogue is the default star source), india_boundary.navin_condition, software.decided (Remotion), generated_images (Route 2 images through the ChatGPT plan with their provenance).
about: The only source of truth for licences in BIE (Task 046a-L). Every licence decision in code reads this file through bie/toolbox/licence.py: the asset library's licence check, the toolbox sources, the registry checks, the resolver, the toolbox page and the lesson gate (lesson_licence_check). Change a verdict here, in a reviewed PR, never in code.
lesson_content: Anything visible or audible in a lesson video, game or notes: pictures, models, maps, data drawn on screen, sounds, fonts' glyphs as shown, text quoted from a source.

classes.reason: non-commercial licence: a paid course cannot use it (Navin: NC bilkul nahi)
no-derivatives licence: BIE crops, labels and animates every asset
share-alike licence: a lesson that adapts it may have to carry the same licence (Navin: CC BY-SA nahi)
a program's copyleft licence (GPL family) on content: like share-alike, refused for lessons
the file carries third-party rights (a named copyright holder)
CC0 or public domain (including the Public Domain Mark and US government works stated as public domain)
made by BIE's own code (drawings, models, charts): no outside licence
CC BY (any version): allowed with a credit (author, licence, licence URL, source page)
a font under the SIL Open Font License: the font file is software; text BIE sets in it is BIE's own (a game or notes page that ships the font file ships the OFL text with it)
custom or own terms (not CC0, public domain or CC BY): blocked until Navin approves the source by name in this file

never_fetched.why: BIE does not even download these (not for lessons, not for internal proofs): a paid course can never use them

own_work.reason: made by BIE's own code (drawings, models, charts); no outside licence. A file BIE made from outside data carries that data's source instead.

needs_navin.why: Government of India content; Acts may be reproduced under the Copyright Act 1957, s. 52(1)(q), with the source acknowledged: own terms, not a CC licence (approved by Navin on 29 October 2026, see approved_by_navin)

free for scientific use with citation (CDS); commercial use under ESA's rules for the Hipparcos catalogue. Navin said yes on 29 October 2026, but ESA's commercial terms still apply: kept out of lessons until ESA's terms are checked; the default star source is yale-bsc (public domain)
the licence page says CC BY 4.0, but the BodyParts3D page asks users to contact DBCLS (approved by Navin on 29 October 2026 as CC BY 4.0 with the credit, see approved_by_navin)
SRTM15+ relief (Tozer et al., 2019, Scripps) is free to use with citation: own terms, not a CC licence (approved by Navin on 29 October 2026 with the citation, see approved_by_navin)

approved_by_navin.words: india-code: allowed with the source acknowledged (s. 52(1)(q))
approved_by_navin.condition: the source acknowledged in the credit: India Code, Legislative Department, Government of India, Copyright Act 1957 s. 52(1)(q)
the citation in the credit: Tozer et al., 2019 (SRTM15+), Scripps Institution of Oceanography, via GMT

approved_by_navin.words: bodyparts3d: allowed as CC BY 4.0 with the credit, as its licence page states
approved_by_navin.condition: the CC BY 4.0 credit: Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), BodyParts3D, licence URL and page URL

per_item.rule: each file on its own: NASA media are US government works, public domain unless the record names a third-party copyright holder; such a file is refused
each file's own licence as Commons states it
each file's own licence as Openverse records it
each model's own licence from its NIH 3D record
each model's own licence (Sketchfab-type sources); not in the registry yet
public domain (NCBI) except depositor records with their own terms

sources.aliases_note: asset source names that are not a registry id: the font's Google Fonts source, and the SRTM15+ relief picture the geo-relief demo recorded as pygmt before Task 046a-L

navin_condition.words: India's political boundary: yes on the condition the law sets
navin_condition.procedure: approve Natural Earth's India-view file only after a side-by-side check against the Survey of India political map, shown to Navin with the review; until then the verdict stays needs_navin

india_boundary.why: any asset or map that draws India's political boundary (including Natural Earth's India-view file) waits until Navin approves a boundary matched to the Survey of India map
india_boundary.not_a_boundary: a land or coastline outline (world-atlas land-110m) draws no political boundary

software.rule: a program's licence (MIT, BSD, Apache, ISC, LGPL, GPL, EPL, NOSA, Remotion's own ...) governs the program, not the pictures BIE makes with it
software.gpl: GPL and LGPL programs (gpl-flagged registry tools such as Blender, PsychoPy, pyGPlates) run only in the cloud, CI or VM render path and never ship inside apps/ (android, web, operator, api)
software.data_is_content: data or models a tool ships with (Z-Anatomy files, the Hipparcos catalogue, Natural Earth maps ...) are content and go through the classes above
